# Script

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A short program or set of automated instructions, typically in Python or Swift, that performs a specific task.

## Scope note

Covers CLI tools and automation scripts (pkm-day, pkm-health, diagnostic/backfill scripts), as distinct from a Shortcut (Apple automation) or a full Project.
